entities.summary: Matthew Scott Strahm is an American professional baseball pitcher for the Kansas City Royals of Major League Baseball (MLB). He has previously played in MLB for the San Diego Padres, Boston Red Sox, and Philadelphia Phillies. As of the 2026 MLB season, Strahm is the only active MLB player born in North Dakota.
